title: India Women's Cricket Team Faces Hong Kong in Asia Cup Match
summary: The Indian women's cricket team is set to play against Hong Kong in their second Group A match of the Women's Asia Cup 2026. The match is crucial for India as a win will help them secure a spot in the semi-finals of the tournament. The coverage includes details on how and where to watch the live streaming of the match.
